user.title: Connect your local battery system
user.description: Your known inverter bridge MQTT root is suggested when its discovery record is available. Review it before continuing. Uses your existing MQTT connection; no serial ports are opened. Scheduling starts disabled.

sources.title: Select measurements
sources.description: Known Daly and inverter bridge sensors are suggested automatically, even after renaming. Review the selected critical-load meter and cell/group order. Multiple or unknown devices need selection. Replacing the meter clears its old heartbeat; use a heartbeat from the new meter or its fresh timestamps. Capacity and backup needs are reviewed in the dashboard.
